en: You have POKéMON with you!\nYou're mine!
The tunnel coming up is pitch-black\ninside.\pYou'll need FLASH to get through\nthere.
Who's that walking there with those\ngood-looking POKéMON?
I'm taking the ROCK TUNNEL to\ngo to LAVENDER…
Are you off to ROCK TUNNEL, too?
You're obviously talented.\nGood luck to you!
Keep it coming, eh!\pOh wait.\nI'm out of POKéMON!
You sure had guts standing up to\nme there, eh?
I got up early every day to raise\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!
WHAT?\pWhat a total waste of time!
I have to collect more than bugs\nto get stronger…
If you don't like BUG POKéMON,\nyou bug me!
